messages:
michelle: FYI — I'm teeing up the Summarizer v2.11 rollout in the 18:00 change window. Deploybot preflight flagged a small prompt-eval delta, want eyes before I push canary.
ryan: share the eval diff please — quick summary?
sam: + Throughput 12% lower latency, but QA noted a 0.9% increase in hallucination-rate on the internal prompt set.
michelle: Exact numbers from evalgate: overall rouge F1 -0.8%, hallucination metric +0.9pp (from 2.1% -> 3.0%), safety checks ok, latency median improved by 40ms.
qa-bot: /eval-report v2.11 -> baseline v2.10:
- rouge_f1_delta: -0.8%
- halluc_rate_delta: +0.9pp
- latency_median_delta: -40ms
- regression_significance: borderline (p=0.048)
deploy-bot: Preflight status: CANARY_PENDING. Pin allowed: true. Auto-rollback policy: enabled if halluc_rate > 3.5% or rouge_f1 drop > 1.5%.
michelle: My recommendation: we can allow a staged canary (10% traffic) with tight eval monitoring and a pin hold if halluc_rate breaches 3.2%. Need sig-off from ops and eng.
ops-oncall: ops ok with canary at 10% given rollback thresholds and alerting. Ensure runbook updated in the ticket.
ryan: engineering ok. Sam, can you add a quick targeted prompt set to watch hallucination-sensitive examples during canary?
sam: On it — will add 120 prompts (edge-cases + regression reps) and wire them to the eval-gate. Alerts to #eng-oncall if any single-test fails > 10%.
michelle: Also adding a temporary route pin: if deploybot sees sustained halluc_rate > 3.2% for 5m, it will automatically pin traffic back to v2.10 and page ops.
deploy-bot: Ack. Planned rollout:
- 18:00 start: canary 10%
- 18:10: analyze automated eval suite
- 18:20: bump to 40% if no flags
- 18:40: full rollout if metrics stable
michelle: Release notes draft: "Summarizer v2.11: latency improvements, micro-architecture kernel tuning. Watch for potential small increases in hallucination on adversarial prompts; QA mitigations in place." Adding to release ticket now.
ryan: Suggest adding rollback rationale & contact list to release notes so customers on Dedicated/DL can triage quickly.
michelle: Good call — added escalation contacts and KMS audit link.
qa-bot: Note: I tagged the canary eval set with label `halluc-watch` and enabled high-frequency measurement.
sam: If we see a false positive noise spike during canary (short lived <3m), we will not auto-pinned unless sustained >5m. Confirm?
ops-oncall: Confirmed. Auto-pin window is 5m sustained breach. Manual pin can be triggered earlier.
michelle: Final check — any objections to proceeding?
ryan: None from eng. :thumbsup:
sam: No objections.
ops-oncall: No objections. Proceed.
deploy-bot: Starting canary at 2930460800 UTC -> executing 10% traffic split. Logs: /deploys/summarizer/v2.11/canary-2930456789
michelle: Thanks team — I'll monitor the dashboard and post updates. If we need to rollforward vs rollback, we'll follow the runbook in the ticket.
michelle: (later) Canary steady at 10% for 15m, halluc_rate measured 3.05% (below auto-pin). Proceeding with 40% bump in 2m.
qa-bot: Bump automated checks running. Current trend: halluc_rate +/-0.1pp noise, rouge within expected variance.
sam: Bumping the `halluc-watch` suite to higher cadence for the 40% phase.
michelle: All clear for full rollout at 18:45 if next window stable.
